_comment: TEMPLATE for the REAL Google sign-in against a DEVELOPMENT Firebase project (SPEC §11.6). NOT used yet. Copy to dev/firebase-web-config.json (git-ignored) and fill in the Web app settings from the Firebase Console (Project settings → Your apps → Web app). These values are public identifiers, NOT secrets: never put a password, a service-account private key or a Google client secret here or anywhere in this repository.
apiKey: <Web API key of the development project>
